routes.label: Equate the functions and take square roots

answerCheck.reason: The difference is x+1-6/x=((x+3)(x-2))/x. It is positive exactly on (-3,0) and (2,∞), excluding the zeros and x=0.

routes.label: Compare the graphs on each branch

answerCheck.reason: The equation x-1=6/x gives (x-3)(x+2)=0, so A=(3,2) and B=(-2,-3). With C=(0,-1), the area is (1/2)·1·(3+2)=5/2.

routes.label: Split the triangle at the y-axis

answerCheck.reason: The conditions require b/(b-1)≤a≤b-1, so b²-3b+1≥0. Since b>2, this gives b≥(3+√5)/2. Equality is attained with a=(1+√5)/2, when both proposed triangles are degenerate.
